Package com.bupt.ta.ai

Class LmResponse

java.lang.Object
com.bupt.ta.ai.LmResponse
public final class LmResponse extends Object
Vendor-neutral result of a language-model completion request.

LmResponse is the standard return type of LmClient.generate(LmRequest). Servlet and service layers should consume only this shape—assistant text, provider label, model name, success flag, and optional diagnostic fields—without parsing provider JSON.

On success, isSuccess() is true and getText() holds the assistant output. On failure, isSuccess() is false and getErrorMessage() explains why; getRawResponse() may still contain the provider payload for debugging (HttpLmClient).

  • Constructor Details

    • LmResponse

      public LmResponse(String text, String provider, String model, boolean success, String rawResponse, String errorMessage)
      Constructs a normalised LM response.
      Parameters:
      text - assistant-generated text; null is stored as empty string
      provider - short provider label (for example "mock" or "http")
      model - model identifier used or reported for this completion
      success - true when generation succeeded and text is meaningful
      rawResponse - optional unparsed provider body for diagnostics; may be null
      errorMessage - human-readable failure reason when success is false; may be null on success
